messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-8274 hosted-inference-prod - HIGH 5xx rate (policy: hosted-critical). Primary: @mike-s, Secondary: @tilly, Manager: @ash-g. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-8274

mike-s: ack'd in mobile at +30s. seeing alert spike on the dashboard. jumping on it. :pager:

emma: looking at traces now — huge spike coincident with canary deploy at 2026-03-15T02:12Z (deploy/2026-03-15-canary-1). logs show repeated 502s from runtime container.

eng-runner: pasting quick pod status:
```
kubectl get pods -n hosted-inference -l app=runtime -o wide
NAME                                READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
runtime-66b7c8d9c-kt9jv             1/1     Running   0          4m   node-usw-3
runtime-66b7c8d9c-zq2nm             0/1     CrashLoop 5          3m   node-usw-2
runtime-66b7c8d9c-xd9p8             1/1     Running   0          4m   node-usw-1
```

customer-ops: customer tickets rolling in — roughly 9–15% of requests failing with 502/503 across EU & US-W. Affected customers include a payment integration (high priority).

mike-s: I acknowledged but PD still shows unacked to secondary? mobile said ack sent. anyone else seeing PD webhook errors?

incident-bot: Note: automatic escalation to secondary fired at +5m after primary acknowledgement did not register with PD webhook delivery (webhook: /integrations/pagerduty). Secondary pinged: @tilly. Manager notified at +6m.

tilly: I didn't get a page initially. just saw this thread. jumping in. can someone shadow the logs for the crashing pod?

emma: logs from crashed instance show rapid OOMs during kvcache eviction path, stack trace: 
```
runtime.err: runtime: out of memory
  at kvcache/evict.go:142
  at inference/decoder.go:87
```
Looks like canary binary linked a different memory config.

ash-g: I'm on the call bridge (dial-in in PD incident). If primary mobile ack didn't propagate we need to fix PD webhook retries after the incident. For now, tilly — can you take over oncall while mike investigates the ack issue?

tilly: taking it. starting mitigation: shifting traffic away from canary pods to dedicated stable pool.

eng-runner: command to shift routing (executed):
```
redwoodctl routing set --service hosted-inference --selector canary=false --pool dedicated-1
```
Returned: OK -> routing change applied, draining canary pods.

mike-s: FYI I saw PD mobile ack timeout logs: `POST /events 504` from pagerduty -> our webhook proxy. Looks like a transient network flap between PD and our ingress. Raising infra ticket but proceeding with mitigation.

customer-ops: after routing change, error rate dropped from 12% -> 2.1% within 90s. still seeing a few spikes from EU region.

eng-runner: scaling stable pool by +2 replicas to absorb load: `kubectl scale deploy/runtime-stable --replicas=6 -n hosted-inference`

emma: re-ran smoke tests against embded API: 200/200 for 3 minutes. logs show no OOMs on stable pods.

tilly: confirming: PD shows secondary was auto-escalated and manager page fired because primary ack didn't get webhooks. we've recorded that as a detection pipeline failure. I'm marking incident as active and delegating MC (mitigation complete) steps to Mike for postmortem.

ash-g: thanks — I'll update on-call rotation note with the webhook retry blind spot and follow up with infra to add a PD webhook health monitor.

customer-ops: posting status page update: `We've mitigated a partial outage affecting hosted inference. Traffic rerouted away from a canary causing errors. No data loss. Root cause under investigation.` Sending now.

mike-s: notes for post-incident actions: (1) PD webhook retry behavior investigation, (2) add synthetic monitor for our webhook endpoint, (3) improve canary memory config test, (4) run a rollback sanity check as part of canary pipeline.

incident-bot: Incident PD-8274 status: RESOLVED (mitigated) — closed at 2026-03-15T02:19Z. Resolution: routing fallback to stable pool and scaling. Please file postmortem with timeline & follow-ups.

tilly: filing preliminary incident doc in /incidents/PD-8274 and assigning postmortem owners. thanks all — good handoff. :white_check_mark:

ash-g: quick retrospective note in thread: manager escalation worked as backup but we should avoid manager pages for expected PD webhook parity failures. We'll add an automation to suppress manager notify if primary ack exists locally but webhook failed.

customer-ops: all clear from customer side, closing major customer tickets after commit message.

mike-s: closing my oncall window early to triage the webhook infra with infra team. ping me if anything else pops.

incident-bot: Thread closed.
